about.body: The AJ200D is Jaguar Land Rover's 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced in 2015. It's fitted across five Land Rover models — the Defender, Discovery, Discovery Sport, Range Rover Evoque and Range Rover Velar — making it one of the most widely-deployed engines in the modern Land Rover range. The engine is available in both single-turbo and twin-turbo configurations, with power outputs ranging from 150 hp to 240 hp depending on the application.

byModel.body: Across the Defender (L663), the AJ200D powers the D150, D165, D180 and D200 variants from 2020 onward. The Discovery (L462) uses it in D165, D180, D200 and D250 specification from 2017. The Discovery Sport (L550) carries the AJ200D across D150, D165, D180 and D200 variants from 2015. The Range Rover Evoque (L551) uses it in D150, D165, D180 and D200 from 2019. And the Range Rover Velar (L560) uses the AJ200D in D180 and D200 from 2017.

compatibility.body: Registration/VIN matching is required — early vs late production variants differ (improvements from 2019 onwards). Single vs twin-turbo variants also differ. A single-turbo AJ200D from a Discovery Sport isn't a direct match for a twin-turbo AJ200D from a Defender, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, turbo setup, and ECU calibration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
